title: Multiphase Clock
source_docs: DSP System Toolbox/Signal Management/Switches and Counters/Multiphase_Clock.md
text: Generate multiple binary clock signals, 1 output; {Clock frequency (Hz)} sets the frequency of all clock signals, {Number of phases, N} sets the number of phases in output vector, {Starting phase (1 to N)} sets the vector index for starting phase, {Number of phase intervals over which clock is active (1 to N-1)} sets the duration of active level for each output, {Active level (polarity)} sets the active level High and {Output data type}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Clock frequency (Hz)
params.values: Frequency of all clock signals 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Number of phases, N
params.values: Number of phases in output vector 4 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Starting phase (1 to N)
params.values: Vector index for starting phase 1 (default) | integer from 1 to N

params.name: Number of phase intervals over which clock is active (1 to N-1)
params.values: Duration of active level for each output 3 (default) | integer from 1 to N -1
